name: com.lalawe/events
title: Lalawe — GTA events
description: Submit in-person Greater Toronto Area events to Lalawe's bilingual (EN/中文) weekend listings.

tools.name: submit_event
tools.description: Send an in-person event in the Greater Toronto Area to Lalawe's review queue. Requirements, all checked: the event happens in person in the GTA (Toronto, Peel, York, Durham or Halton region); it hasn't ended (Toronto time); the title and description are given in BOTH English (title, description) and Simplified Chinese (title_zh, description_zh) — translate them yourself, faithfully, before calling. A person reviews it before it appears on lalawe.com. Returns a submission id; problems come back as a list to fix and resend. Limits: one call every 15s, 20 per day.

title.description: Event name in English (as the organizer writes it, no date in it).

description.description: What it is, who it's for, what to expect — in English, a few sentences, plain text.

description_zh.description: The same description in Simplified Chinese.

start_time.description: Start time, 24-hour HH:MM, Toronto local. Omit if unknown.

end_date.description: Last day for a multi-day event, YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for a one-day event.

end_time.description: End time, 24-hour HH:MM. Omit if unknown.

city.description: GTA municipality, e.g. Toronto, North York, Scarborough, Markham, Richmond Hill, Vaughan, Mississauga, Brampton, Oakville.

address.description: Street address, ideally with postal code.

in_person.description: Must be true: the event happens in person (not online).

price.description: Price as shown to attendees, e.g. "$15, kids free".

is_free.description: true if free to attend, false if paid. Omit if unknown.

event_url.description: The organizer's own page for this event (http/https).

image_url.description: A poster or photo of the event (http/https, jpg/png/webp).

contact_email.description: How the reviewer can reach the submitter (not published).

note.description: Anything the reviewer should know (not published).

tools.name: check_submission
tools.description: Look up the review status of a submission by the id submit_event returned: pending, approved (with the event's public URL) or rejected (with the reviewer's reason).
